overall_summary: Leena Rao’s resume provides strong evidence of Python-based workflow and integration engineering, including constrained assistant actions, human approval gates, argument validation, recoverable execution, idempotency, bounded action attempts, and failure-path testing. It also contains concrete evidence of agentic workflow design, system reliability, and applied safety controls. The resume provides limited detail about underlying AI/ML/LLM concepts and no meaningful evidence of retrieval-augmented generation, making those useful areas to probe during the interview.
